key_points: Institutional investors bought over 5 million AMZN shares across several funds, indicating confidence.
Amazon signed an $8 billion long‑term supply agreement with Generac for data‑center backup power, strengthening its AI infrastructure.
Amazon announced higher wages to support its next growth phase, aiming to improve retention and productivity.
Amazon blocked Meta’s Muse AI agent from proxy buying on its platform, underscoring competitive friction in AI‑agent space.
Anthropic (Amazon‑backed) alleged data transfers by DeepSeek and Moonshot, keeping Amazon in AI‑policy headlines without direct financial effect.
